summary.text: Whittney Wood is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 73, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is running to address affordable housing and the influence of corporations and wealthy donors.

paragraphs.text: Whittney Wood was born in Lancaster, Ohio, and earned a high school diploma from Fairfield Union High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Wood said she grew up in Thurston, relies on Fairfield Medical Center for most of her healthcare, coaches her daughter's t-ball team, and works throughout District 73.
Wood said in the survey that her background is practical rather than political and that she will not bow to big money.
She said Ohio has a shortage of affordable housing rather than of available housing, and objected to property management firms buying single-family homes.
